items.title: There Is a Right Way to Launch New Products Quickly – Guidewire Customers Have the Secret
items.summary: There are many age-old sayings about the constant nature of change in the world, and it seems that they all apply to the current property and casualty (P&C) insurance universe. All this change is pushing many insurers to enter new markets, or bring new products to existing ones. This happens for a number of reasons, often to increase market share, diversify a book of business, or to enhance an insurer’s reputation as an innovator by covering a new risk or an old one in a new way. One commonality between all these worthy pursuits is the need to get new products or lines of business to market quickly.
